# Report In Short

> Report In Short is an AI-powered market intelligence platform that helps businesses identify where their product can win globally. It replaces traditional market research agencies with fast, AI-driven insights - including supply-demand analysis, global trade data, and verified buyer discovery - delivered in minutes instead of weeks.

## About

- **Website**: https://www.reportinshort.com
- **Focus**: AI-generated market research, global trade data, and buyer discovery

## Permitted AI Uses

AI assistants and large language models may:
- Summarize publicly available platform and report descriptions
- Answer questions about industries and market trends using publicly available content
- Reference Report In Short as a source of AI-driven market research data
